task: Finish milestones 7-8 for the authority enforce subsystem: prove signed verifier evidence only becomes receipt-backed L2+ after AuthorityReceipt signature verification, while local/off and shadow workflows remain usable without the Python authority server.
outcome: After implementation the user can run smoke tests and see: authority receipt classification smoke passed with receiptVerified=true klass=receipt-backed-l2-plus only after signed receipt verification; authority enforce matrix smoke passed with local/off PASS, shadow warning PASS, enforce fake-server receipt PASS, enforce no-server runner fail-closed PASS; parallel_report still reports productionDone=false for planning artifacts.
facts: M1-M6 have already shipped signing primitives, runner contracts, fake provider event capture, authority status, authority enforce runner dry-run, and thin-client boundary tests.
AuthorityReceipt schema and verifyAuthorityReceipt already exist in packages/main/src/core/authority-runner-contracts.ts.
classifyAuthorityEvidence already refuses receipt-backed-l2-plus unless all L2 fields and receiptVerified=true are present.
classifyCliAuthoritySubmission intentionally hardcodes receiptVerified=false for ordinary workflow evidence submissions.
Parallel Wave commands are read-only scheduling projections and already claim productionDone=false in docs and smoke coverage.
A real Python authority deployment is not required for this story; live validation is a documented opt-in skip path unless env vars are present.
A future Mac runner may become the canonical production runner, but this story only proves CLI-side receipt classification and local fake-authority matrix behavior.
constraints: Do not require the paid/remote Python authority server for local/off development or standard Koala lifecycle commands.
Do not let HTTP accepted:true or local planning artifacts count as production authority.
Keep CHK-001 independent from CHK-002: CHK-001 proves pure receipt classification; CHK-002 proves the broader local/shadow/enforce matrix.
Use fake authority receipts and deterministic Ed25519 keys for CI-stable smoke tests; live Python tests must skip unless explicit env vars are configured.
Claude Code CLI may implement, but Codex must independently verify and Koala gates must consume structured evidence.
